question: Why is purity primary only for the one consciousness-lord, while other purity is partial and by his will?
premises: Purity is primary for one consciousness-lord.
Other purity is partial from all sides.
Such other purity occurs by his will.
inference: Only the consciousness-lord has primary purity; all other purity is partial and dependent on his will.
uncertainties: aṃśāṃśikātaḥ may mean partiality of parts.
plain_english: Purity is primary for the one consciousness-lord; elsewhere it is partial, by his will.
